label: development, not a verdict
reading: BY TYPE, declared before any score. The typed arm is read type by type on the pressure-day type of the target day (turn, quarter_end_turn, tax_date, year_end, ordinary), each with 20 or more target days, on grid CRPS and the 90% band coverage, against the candidate. The pooled-scale arm is read on the two groups it changes or leaves alone: all non-ordinary target days together (a gain there is its claim) and ordinary target days (which it leaves element for element as the candidate, so a difference there is a bug). A pooled figure over all days is shown but never read alone: a gain is a gain only where its type-level reading agrees, and a pooled gain that no type carries is not one. A type of fewer than 20 target days is listed with its coverage and not read
reading_rules: A figure is a check on days that were already seen. Nothing here is a verdict, nothing is registered and no choice is made on it; (s3c-ann-net) stays the frozen H5 candidate.
A gain or loss is read from the 90% interval of mean d excluding zero; otherwise undecided. A point estimate alone is not read.
A pooled figure is never read without the lead, regime and pressure-day-type splits beside it, and a gain is read by type (see reading.which_reading).

Nothing is adopted. Whether a day-type scale joins the registered candidate, and whether its result changes what the registration says about the known limits, is hers; the page ends with a marked question whose default changes no claim.
